statements.impact_statement: The advisory flags golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp as unmaintained and unsafe by design; it has no fixed version. x/crypto is an indirect dependency of the turf CLI and only the openpgp subpackage is affected. Both govulncheck and osv-scanner call-analysis report no call path from any turf entrypoint to x/crypto/openpgp — it is imported-but-not-called. Re-review if a dependency (or first-party code) ever calls into x/crypto/openpgp.
